sources.name: OCNLI
sources.purpose: 中文矛盾压力测试 (contradiction pairs)
sources.license_note: Non-commercial; use labeled dev set; exclude '-' no-consensus labels per plan
sources.exclusion_rule: Drop label='-' (50 rows, no annotator consensus). Drop non-contradiction for primary contradiction test set.

sources.name: PAWS-X-zh
sources.purpose: 同义与高词汇重叠非同义对照
sources.license: Google dataset license (free use any purpose, AS IS)
sources.domain_gap_note: Generic sentence pairs differ from personality short-phrases; cannot estimate real write frequency. Used as forced same-slot stress test.

sources.name: PersonaMem-v2
sources.purpose: 核心偏好更新及对话重放
sources.preference_updates_type: dict keyed by preference description; value contains old/new update details
sources.pii_warning: sensitive_information contains PII (address, email, phone, SSN, etc) — must NOT enter git or memory store
sources.english_synthetic_note: English synthetic data; update pairs != same-merge labels; require human review

sources.name: Memora
sources.purpose: 失效记忆使用与有效记忆保留 (benchmark extension)
sources.note: Optional extension after phases B/C. Run after core pilot. Shares existing API+token budget.

schema_check_protocol: Use 10 items per source not entering formal set to check schema before fixed random seed sampling
split_rule: PersonaMem by persona, OCNLI by prem_id, PAWS-X by traceable original pair. ~half dev, half locked test. Same group + paraphrases/translations cannot cross sets.
dedup_rule: Record candidate total, dedup, and filter rule before formal sampling. Do not duplicate samples to fill quota.
